name: io.github.GaillumXc/profili-mcp
title: Profili MCP
description: MCP server for the legacy Profili 2.x airfoil software. 14 tools: airfoil-library search, geometry export/import, polar read and XFOIL batch computation, thickness/camber redesign, and GUI process control — via direct read/write access to the Profili Jet database, its bundled XFOIL engine, and the application process.
